Locked Earn is a fixed lock-up financial product launched by LBank. Users cannot redeem funds early during the lock-up period and, in return, can obtain relatively stable returns.
How are Locked Earn returns generated?

Locked Earn returns come from the platform’s periodic operation of locked assets and the yield pricing mechanism corresponding to the lock-up period, as well as promotional rewards that LBank may provide through marketing campaigns. Returns are calculated according to the rules after the product is established and are settled uniformly on the settlement date.
Why haven’t I received my returns yet?

Common reasons include: the product is still in the lock-up period and returns have not yet been settled; the settlement date has not been reached; returns are distributed uniformly after settlement rather than daily. Please refer to the settlement date displayed on the product page.
When can I redeem the tokens I previously invested?

Locked Earn must be held until the end of the lock-up period. Upon reaching the settlement date, the principal and returns will be returned according to the rules. Early redemption is generally not supported during the lock-up period (if supported, returns will be affected).
How to participate in Locked Earn?
1. Visit and log in to LBank official website;

1. Earnings will start accruing at 00:00 (UTC+0) on the day following your subscription. Interest will be redeemed together with the principal to your spot account upon maturity.2. Estimated earnings at maturity = Principal × Annualized yield / 365 × Product duration (days)3. The annual interest rate for subscribed locked-term products is not fixed and may change daily. The final settlement at maturity shall prevail. The annual interest rate does not represent the actual or expected return in fiat terms.
